description: We are a team of computer science students from Egypt with a passion for front-end development, creative design, and storytelling. We love building interactive, engaging web experiences that go beyond simple information pages.
summary: Cosmic Campsite is an interactive space-learning experience that brings together a browser-based educational website and the companion Space Adventurer game. The website guides visitors through the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space, introducing real spacecraft and scientific equipment, mission stories, discoveries, and exploration milestones. Visitors can choose a destination, explore mission hardware, read artifact stories, follow a timeline, answer quiz questions, and track their learning progress. The companion game extends the space theme through interactive play and invites users to engage with the subject in a hands-on way. Together, these experiences aim to make space exploration more engaging, memorable, and accessible to learners.
details:
Cosmic Campsite combines an educational website with a companion space-themed game to create an engaging way to learn about space exploration. On the website, users choose between the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space, then explore related spacecraft and equipment, read stories about real missions and artifacts, and follow milestones in a mission timeline. Destination-related quizzes and a progress journal help users review what they have learned and see their progress through the experience.

The companion Space Adventurer game adds an interactive play component to the project. Together, the website and game offer different ways to engage with the project’s space exploration theme, supporting both guided learning and hands-on discovery.

The website was developed with HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript ES modules, and JSON data files. It uses NASA imagery and mission information to connect the learning experience to real exploration. The project is designed to make space science approachable, interactive, and memorable for a broad audience.
